description: Frozen latest live gas records from the 2026-11-01 export (scrape run 30) for the Phase 7D tests: every residential gas record plus FortisBC Energy Commercial Rate 2 (commercial gas models are withheld). Centra's records are the stored August-priced versions; tests use them only as frozen inputs.

records.name: Alternative Technology and Appliance Delivery Service (North)
records.eligibility: Available by request only and at the discretion of the company for use to all Customers: Using less than 40 GJ per year, and Have one of the following use types: Uses alternative technologies that reduce natural gas space heating load including solar thermal, geoexchange, and net zero/near net zero emission homes; or Uses natural gas solely for non-space heating purposes.
records.source_page: ATCO Gas North Rate Schedules, August 1, 2026 edition, PDF page 14
records.notes: Provenance: live_parsed. ATCO Gas North Alternative Technology and Appliance Delivery Service from the AUC-approved North rate schedules (August 1, 2026 edition); base charges effective January 1, 2026. Conditional eligibility: available by request only, at ATCO Gas's discretion. Gas supply is not included: Direct Energy Regulated Services' default rate tariff (DSP Rider F) names Low, Mid and High Use delivery service only, and retailer contract prices are excluded. Conditional: Rider A (municipal franchise fee) and Rider B (municipal property tax and specific costs) add a percentage that varies by municipality to all charges for customers in the listed municipalities; not included. GST is not included.
